ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-G in the area bounded by:

      West Balmoral Avenue; North Broadway Avenue; West Foster Avenue; and the alley next west of and
      parallel to North Broadway Avenue,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.



                                                       ____________________________
                                                       Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                       Alderwoman, 48th Ward

Common Addresses:
5200-5358 N. Broadway Avenue
